overall: AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: executive sessions on the Medeiros Farm purchase fell under Purpose 6, and the Board's handling of the First Complaint was proper. Other allegations declined as outside the OML.

allegations.summary: Second complaint alleged six executive sessions (Aug 2021 to June 2022) on Medeiros Farm topics were improper under Purpose 6. Board argued untimeliness; AG rejected that.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that, on the whole, the Board's discussions were appropriate for executive session under Purpose 6.

allegations.summary: First complaint alleged the Board held improper executive sessions, without identifying any particular session.
allegations.key_passage: although the complaint alleges that executive sessions were improperly held, it does not identify any particular executive sessions alleged to have been improperly held.

allegations.summary: First complaint alleged the Board failed to vote in open session to designate a negotiator and to accept an appraisal for Medeiros Farm.
allegations.key_passage: In general, the Open Meeting Law does not require that a public body discuss any particular matter or take any particular votes

allegations.summary: Second complaint alleged the Board failed to take certain votes in open session and that this violated Town bylaws and processes.
allegations.key_passage: Where these allegations, even if true, would not constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law, we decline to review them.

allegations.summary: First complaint alleged the Board did not respond to a public records request for minutes and notices.
allegations.key_passage: Again, even if true, none of these allegations would constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law and we therefore decline to review them.

allegations.summary: First complaint alleged a former board chair had a conflict of interest regarding Medeiros Farm, which the AG does not review under the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Again, even if true, none of these allegations would constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law and we therefore decline to review them.

allegations.summary: First complaint alleged the warrant article on the Medeiros Farm purchase was presented at Town Meeting by the Community Preservation Committee chair, not the Board chair.
allegations.key_passage: Again, even if true, none of these allegations would constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law and we therefore decline to review them.

allegations.summary: Second complaint alleged the Board did not discuss the First Complaint in sufficient detail at its Dec. 17, 2025 meeting and that counsel drafted a prepared response beforehand.
allegations.key_passage: We find no violation with respect to the allegations that the Board did not discuss the First Complaint in sufficient detail and that legal counsel drafted a response prior to the Board's meeting to review the First Complaint.

allegations.summary: Second complaint alleged the Board failed to appoint individuals to the Town-created Medeiros Farm Committee, in violation of Town bylaws.
allegations.key_passage: Where these allegations, even if true, would not constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law, we decline to review them.
